items.item_text: Undergraduate coursework and/or equivalent experience in plant science, horticulture, or relevant field(s).
Experience with grape, berry, and tree micro-shoot tip culture.
Experience in producing inventory lists of transplanted plants and sterile culture propagation for use in updating computer databases.
Experience labeling plant materials and recording inventories of performed work.
Experience with tissue culture technology including microbiology and sterile technique.

Under supervision, perform standard laboratory procedures for the excision, transfer and maintenance of meristem tip-cultures of grapevines, roses, strawberries, sweet potatoes, trees and any additional crop added to the program as deemed necessary. In instances where meristem excision protocol requires establishment of cuttings, collect, establish and transfer cuttings from trees and any additional crop as deemed necessary. Utilize standard media, reagents, and solutions.
80% - Perform Tissue Culture For FPS Crops
5% - Participate In Efforts To Maintain An Efficient Smooth-Running Department
Familiarity with UC laboratory safety requirements.
Knowledge of and skills to cut <0.5 mm meristem tips from crop plants with high rate of survival using dissecting microscope.
Skill and ability to work independently with minimum supervision and as part of a team.
Knowledge of and skills of sterile culture propagation techniques to establish seeds, cuttings, and meristems in sterile culture.
Knowledge of and skills to transplant sterile culture-grown plants into non-sterile environments.
